protocol.statistic: For geometric means B,N of the two calls per label in each block, E=N-B-max(.05*B,.001). Upper-tail alpha1/40 attainable order-statistic upper bound; median ratio descriptive; minima never decide acceptance.
protocol.interpretation: Conditional statistical diagnostics only. Randomization, an A/A pass and one session cannot prove independence or common medians. Review results to choose a new finite candidate experiment budget before seeing candidate timing; do not reinterpret historical failed admissions.
